_comment: prediction.v1 Task template. The tasks submit CLI resolves two sentinels:
* window.startTs = 0       -> Date.now() at post time; endTs + resolveTs follow
* threshold = "current"  -> current Chainlink price at post time
Default: a coin-flip direction question: will ETH/USD be higher than right now
one hour from now, at resolveTs (endTs + 15min)? Swap operator to LT for a
downside question, or use "current+0.5%" / "current-1%" for biased thresholds.
